name: Ban / local processing requirement
legal_question: Does the law ban cross-border transfer of data or require data to be processed locally?
probe_keywords: data must be processed within the country
ban on transfer of data overseas
in_scope: Outright ban on transferring (personal) data outside the jurisdiction
Requirement that data be processed only on domestic systems
Prohibition on transfer to a specific country
out_of_scope: Data localisation measures applied only to government data (excluded by methodology)
Voluntary or commercial decisions to process data locally

bands.criteria: Ban and/or local processing requirement for all sectors or for personal data, OR more than one measure of the 0.5 category
Ban and/or local processing requirement applied to a specific sector, specific data, non-personal data, or transfer prohibited to one country
No requirement

name: Local storage requirement
legal_question: Does the law require data to be stored on servers located within the country?
probe_keywords: data must be stored within the country
retain a copy of data locally
in_scope: Mandatory domestic storage of (personal) data
Requirement to keep a local copy of data held or transferred abroad
Server/storage location mandate
out_of_scope: Local storage measures applied only to government data (excluded by methodology)

bands.criteria: Local storage requirement for all sectors or for personal data, OR more than one measure of the 0.5 category
Local storage requirement applied to a specific sector, specific data or non-personal data
No requirement

name: Infrastructure requirement
legal_question: Does the law require the use of local computing infrastructure (e.g. local servers or data centres) to handle data?
in_scope: Requirement to use locally located servers, data centres or computing facilities
Mandate to route or host services through domestic infrastructure
out_of_scope: Infrastructure measures applied only to government data (excluded by methodology)

bands.criteria: Infrastructure requirement present
No requirement

name: Conditional cross-border flow regime
legal_question: Does the law permit cross-border data transfer only if certain conditions are met (consent, adequacy, contractual safeguards, approval)?
in_scope: Transfer permitted only subject to conditions: consent, adequacy/comparable protection, contractual safeguards (SCCs/BCRs), certification or regulatory approval
Accountability conditions imposed on the transferring organisation
out_of_scope: Conditional-flow measures applied only to government data (excluded by methodology)

bands.criteria: Conditions imposed for all sectors or for personal data
Conditions imposed for specific data or non-personal data
No condition

name: Binding international data-transfer commitments
legal_question: Is the economy party to an international agreement with binding commitments on cross-border data flows?
probe_keywords: commitment not to require data localisation
in_scope: Membership of / ratification of an agreement with binding cross-border data-flow commitments (e.g. CPTPP, DEPA, RCEP e-commerce chapter, bilateral digital economy agreements)
out_of_scope: Non-binding declarations or memoranda of understanding without enforceable data-flow commitments

bands.criteria: Not committed to any binding agreement on data flows
Committed to a binding agreement on data flows

name: Comprehensive data protection framework
legal_question: Does the economy have a comprehensive (cross-sectoral) personal data protection law?
in_scope: A comprehensive / horizontal personal data protection statute applying across sectors
Sectoral-only data protection laws (partial framework)
Establishment of a data protection authority/commission under such a law

bands.criteria: No data protection legal framework
Data protection legal framework only for specific sectors (sectoral law)
Comprehensive data protection framework

name: Dedicated cybersecurity framework
legal_question: Does the economy have a dedicated, horizontal cybersecurity law?
in_scope: A dedicated, horizontal cybersecurity statute
Critical information infrastructure (CII) protection obligations
Establishment of a national cybersecurity authority
Sectoral or non-dedicated cybersecurity provisions (partial framework)
out_of_scope: General personal data protection law without cybersecurity-specific obligations (scored under P7-I1)

bands.criteria: No cybersecurity legal framework
Non-dedicated cybersecurity framework and/or dedicated cybersecurity law only for specific sectors (sectoral law)
Dedicated, horizontal cybersecurity legal framework

name: Minimum data retention requirement
legal_question: Does the law impose a minimum period for retaining personal or communications data?
probe_keywords: retain personal data for a period
in_scope: A mandatory minimum period for retaining personal or communications/traffic data
Statutory data-preservation obligations imposing a retention floor
out_of_scope: Data retention measures applied only to government data (excluded by methodology)
Maximum retention limits / storage-limitation duties (these reduce, not impose, retention)

bands.criteria: Minimum period of data retention requirement present
No data retention requirement

name: DPIA / DPO requirement
legal_question: Does the law require Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA) or the appointment of a Data Protection Officer (DPO)?
probe_keywords: designate an individual responsible for compliance
individual responsible for ensuring compliance with the Act
business contact information of the individual
in_scope: A requirement to designate or appoint one or more individuals responsible for ensuring the organisation's compliance with the data protection law — this IS the DPO requirement even if the statute calls them an 'individual responsible for compliance' rather than 'Data Protection Officer'
Mandatory appointment of a Data Protection Officer (DPO)
Mandatory Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) for processing
out_of_scope: Voluntary best-practice guidance not imposed by law

bands.criteria: DPO and DPIA, or only DPO requirement, applied to all sectors
DPO and DPIA, or only DPO requirement, applied to a specific sector
No requirement

name: Government access to personal data
legal_question: Does the law allow government authorities to access personal data, particularly without a court order?
probe_keywords: power to access computer or data
power to require production of documents or data
disclosure of personal data to authorities
access to data without a warrant
in_scope: Powers allowing authorities to access, intercept or compel disclosure of personal data
Access permitted without prior judicial authorisation (court order/warrant)
out_of_scope: Access strictly conditioned on a judicial warrant with no exception
Routine data-subject access requests by individuals (scored under data protection principles, not here)

bands.criteria: Any measure that allows government to access data without court orders
No such measure (access only with a court order)
